A1.justification: Both complete 18-page PDFs describe ARK and contain readable text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–D. Text and visual inspection support reliable comparison; all seven appendix pages match exactly.

before.justification: v2 reports original QA benchmark, ablation, and generator-transfer results in Tables 1–3, plus KG-construction measurements and additional win rates in appendix Tables 5 and 7.

after.justification: v3 reports original ARK experiments in Tables 1–3 and empirical KG-construction and win-rate measurements in Appendices A and D. Retaining these results from v2 does not change their empirical status.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithms 1–3 retain the same KG construction, PPR subgraph extraction, query augmentation, three alignment scores, and three-stage contrastive curriculum. No algorithm, architecture, objective, or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions retain Finance/Legal training data, five LongBench QA datasets, five UltraDomain evaluation domains, and the Legal-subset KG-construction study (Section 4.1; Appendix A.4). No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 7 retain Full, Qwen3-embedding, BGE-M3, Stella-v5, Jina-emb-v3, GraphRAG, LightRAG, HippoRAG, and MemoRAG. Comparator membership also matches in Tables 3 and 5. The newly cited works are not added to experimental comparisons.

E3.justification: Both retain the Qwen3-embedding 0.6B retriever, Mistral-7B default generator, 512-token chunks with 12-token overlap, top-five retrieval, and F1/pairwise win-rate evaluation. Training settings, sample sizes, and appendix study protocols are unchanged.

E4.justification: The alignment-removal and curriculum-stage ablations (Table 2), generator-transfer analysis (Table 3), and LLM-choice/construction-cost analysis (Appendix A.4, Table 5) retain the same questions and evidence.

E5.justification: Section 4.2 reports average pairwise win rates over five runs in both versions. Run information and statistical reporting remain unchanged; neither version reports seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 1–3, 5, and 7 match. For example, ARK retains F1 scores of 20.60 on MuSiQue and 42.35 on HotpotQA in Table 1. Transfer findings, construction statistics, and appendix win rates are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The PPR equations and approximation/complexity discussion in Section 3.2.2, alignment definitions and contrastive losses in Section 3.3, and appendix mathematical content are unchanged. No assumption, proof, or derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about answer-centric KG-guided retriever tuning, architectural compatibility, and benchmark performance. The claims of leading performance on eight of ten datasets and 14.5% average F1 improvement are unchanged.

C2.justification: Both retain the same interpretations of alignment and curriculum effects, the NarrativeQA transfer decline with Llama-3.1, and KG-construction cost tradeoffs. Limitations concerning benchmark representativeness and noisy KG extraction/linking are unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 4.2 and Appendices A–D retain the same hardware/software information, hyperparameters in Tables 4 and 6, implementation algorithms, and prompt listings. The source-code availability statement and repository address are also unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds seven cited works: RACQC, GRAIL, SciRAG, GRO-RAG, Disco-RAG, SE-Search, and Unlocking Implicit Experience. These appear through introduction citations and a generic additional sentence in Section 2.2, modestly expanding coverage without substantively revising ARK's positioning.

P1.justification: v3 reverses the equal-contributing authors' order, simplifies affiliations to Shanghai Jiao Tong University, reorders email addresses, and adds a brief related-work sentence. The section sequence and scientific narrative otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2 moves from the left to the right column on page 3, and Table 1 moves from page 7 to page 8, with accompanying text and table reflow. Figure artwork, table structures and captions, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The added citations broaden bibliographic coverage, but Section 2.2 provides only a generic acknowledgment of the additional works. Scientific arguments, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations remain unchanged, including the appendices. Author-line edits and limited layout reflow leave overall paper quality essentially the same.
